findings_not_fixed.title: Issue denial deletes the original recovery identity (D4)
findings_not_fixed.repro: Send a stage write and lose its response; revoke issue access and receive the structured denial. clearCollaborationAccess calls clearCollaborationDrafts, which removes the entire stage intent. Reload the denied detail: no original key remains and the early return renders no stage recovery control.
findings_not_fixed.impact: An operation may have committed, but its original account can no longer inspect the permitted content-free O1 receipt. Retaining the full body would instead retain revoked private content.
findings_not_fixed.recommendation: Split the persisted stage record into a sendable intent and a content-free recovery-only identity. On issue denial erase body/prose and retain only actor/server/issue/action/key plus matching IDs/versions/digests/expiry. Recovery-only records must never reach POST/resend. Render a small GET-only recovery surface from the denied CollaborationDetail branch, without an issue DTO. Keep account/logout teardown destructive for both forms. Reuse stage-intent, stage-actions recovery, and the existing account-only guard; do not create another operation endpoint.
findings_not_fixed.coverage: stage-intent.test.ts currently asserts full erasure, so the green test encodes D4. Replace it and add denied-detail recovery and account-switch cases.

findings_not_fixed.title: Source denial leaves other candidates’ private cache readable
findings_not_fixed.repro: Read candidates A and B, leaving B cached. Lose source membership, keep issue participation, and obtain A’s exact baseline:null denial. Select B while its refetch is held. B still has available cached R4 data, so its PR/build/decision reasons render until the new response arrives. An earlier B request has no source-denial epoch fence either.
findings_not_fixed.impact: Private source details can reappear after this issue has already established that source evidence is withheld. The current selected form cleanup test does not cover sibling caches or late responses.
findings_not_fixed.recommendation: Introduce a source-evidence erasure/fence for this issue’s R4 entries on the exact denied projection. Cancel without rollback, remove private baselines/reasons/reports/facts across cached candidates, reject older in-flight responses, and require a current authorized read before restoring evidence. Preserve allowed issue identity and original-key recovery.
findings_not_fixed.coverage: Add a two-candidate Query/Views regression and a denied-A/late-B response race.

findings_not_fixed.title: Reason-only return incorrectly requires source evidence
findings_not_fixed.repro: Use an active designated reviewer/QA with current issue participation but no source membership. R1 supplies current roles/stage and R4 supplies the exact current candidate identity with baseline:null. A return with reason, null expiry, all-null evidence and [] dependencies is allowed by the approve-only evidence contract, yet presentation returns an empty action set, preparation rejects missing baseline, and the form exits before a return can be composed.
findings_not_fixed.impact: A legitimate human cannot return work solely because they cannot read the source evidence, even though return grants no approval and can carry no evidence.
findings_not_fixed.recommendation: Derive reason-only return authority from current role/stage/candidate identity independently of source-read/approval eligibility. Offer a content-free return form; require source authority only for optional evidence/dependencies actually supplied. Keep approve and source rendering blocked.
findings_not_fixed.coverage: Add source-denied current-role return positive case and wrong-role/optional-hidden-evidence negative cases.

findings_not_fixed.title: Fresh discovery cannot invalidate stale R4 controls
findings_not_fixed.repro: Hold cached R4 A as current, then refresh issue/R1 together so discovery marks A superseded or stale and B current. Candidate identity/lifecycle/role revision in cached R4 A is unchanged. deriveCollaborationStageCodeState ignores the matching discovery entry and still offers approval/advance; preparation can capture the new workflow revision with A’s obsolete current state.
findings_not_fixed.impact: The UI knowingly offers an old approval/transition despite a newer authoritative candidate discovery. Server rejection remains the final protection; this is not evidence of a server authorization bypass.
findings_not_fixed.recommendation: Require coherent R1 CandidateRef/state and R4 identity/state for authorizing controls, and refetch the selected record after discovery changes. Preserve independent revocation of superseded, unconsumed decisions.
findings_not_fixed.coverage: Add a R1-new/R4-old canonical presentation case and an open-form refresh regression.

findings_not_fixed.title: Policy read access is treated as policy write authority (D8)
findings_not_fixed.repro: A source-workspace member who is not owner/admin opens Project stage policy. P1 legitimately returns enabled:true (or disabled plus activation_available:true). The panel computes disable/enable only from those fields, renders an active form, and prepares PUT without current source administration authority.
findings_not_fixed.impact: Ordinary members see an administrative action that is guaranteed to be refused; activation_available describes rollout availability, not that viewer’s permission. The backend still enforces authority.
findings_not_fixed.recommendation: Use the existing explicit source-workspace membership/permission query (e.g. useCurrentMember(memberListOptions) with the captured workspace and current successful authority) for policy-write affordances. Keep read-only policy facts visible to allowed readers. Do not use managed-only configure_roles to hide first enablement. The existing useCurrentMember wrapper exposes isLoading but not query errors; do not treat it alone as a reliable current-authority proof after failure. If the underlying source-member query cannot supply reliable current authority in this account scope, request a server-owned P1 can_manage/revise_policy hint; the client must not expand the frozen wire itself.
findings_not_fixed.coverage: Add owner/admin/member/unknown/denied UI cases without inventing a new policy wire capability.

findings_not_fixed.title: Failed R1/P1 refreshes leave stale forms writable
findings_not_fixed.repro: Load valid R1/P1 and open a form. Make a background R1 or P1 refresh throw a transient network/500 error while the other queries remain cached and successful. TanStack Query retains data; both view/policy and locked ignore query.error, so stage/policy submissions remain enabled. The same issue exists for A4 after R3 failure. R4’s query.isError guard covers only R4.
findings_not_fixed.impact: The panel displays an authority-read error while still allowing writes from the failed read’s old state. Form input should survive, but submission should wait for a successful refresh.
findings_not_fixed.recommendation: Keep retained inputs and show retry, but propagate required-read error state to each form’s read/prepare lock. Apply consistently to R1, P1 and R3; preserve recovery GET even when content reads fail.
findings_not_fixed.coverage: Add a transient-refetch failure with retained data for stage, policy and proposal decision controls, then successful explicit refresh.

findings_not_fixed.title: Contradictory revoked approval is still selected as valid
findings_not_fixed.repro: Start with stageCodeReviewDecisionFixture, retain state:"valid", and add a well-formed non-null revocation. The R4 schema accepts both, and validDecisions does not inspect revocation; a business owner/reviewer can still get the QA advance or use the decision as a preceding approval.
findings_not_fixed.impact: A malformed new response exposes an approval as authorizing even though its same projection explicitly records revocation. This is a response-drift/client boundary issue, not a claim that the server emits that combination.
findings_not_fixed.recommendation: Reject the contradictory state/revocation combination in the pure schema and exclude revoked records defensively from validDecisions. Add the small canonical malformed-response regression.
findings_not_fixed.coverage: Existing schema tests cover CI shape and unknown states, but not decision terminal-fact contradictions.
